bias_note: Relief bounce into a heavy week, not a trend change: chips are on their longest weekly losing streak since November and oil is still near 6-month highs. Fade-the-gap risk Monday; size down Tue 10 AM, Wed 2 PM, Thu 8:30 AM.

grok.bias: mixed — short-term risk-on from futures bounce and oil dip, but caution from elevated geopolitics, AI demand questions, and upcoming FOMC.
items: Little Dog Capital (~8:10 PM ET): Equity futures rising ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy decision as markets position for potential stabilization after the S&P 500's prior decline.
Rattan Amol (~7:42 PM ET): Sunday night flip — Nasdaq futures up 0.6% while WTI slipped to $101.61 as oil cools; after brutal Friday, traders head into Fed week with a little breathing room.
Bag Investing (~8:11 PM ET): Neocloud stocks like $CRWV, $NBIS, $IREN crushed as market questions AI demand, debt levels, and returns on massive infrastructure investments.
BeaconDesk (~8:09 PM ET): FOMC meeting Oct 27-28 key event; oil prices and inflation expectations could influence rate outlook and risk appetite.
Chris Rainbow (~8:11 PM ET): Oil has risen from $72 to $117 on Iranian strategy; Trump not attacking today but tensions keep crude elevated.
grok.pulse: Equity futures rising with Nasdaq up ~0.6% as oil cools to ~$102 on Sunday open after Friday's selloff, ahead of FOMC amid lingering AI doubts and Iran tensions.
grok.trump: Trump ruled out an immediate Iran strike; oil remains elevated near multi-month highs on residual Middle East tensions but cooling at the Sunday reopen.
grok.watch: Monday open continuation of futures bounce, whether oil holds above $100, NQ/ES reaction to AI headlines, and positioning into Wednesday FOMC decision plus Mag7 earnings.

S&P 500 futures at Sunday-night open vs Friday settle (Bloomberg)

news.headline: Nasdaq 100 futures +0.6%, S&P futures +0.4% at the Sunday open; Brent down over 1% to about $115.
news.why: Gap-up open after two losing weeks; watch if it holds into NY AM.

news.headline: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted Houthi missiles and drones over Riyadh; Houthis claim hits on Yanbu/Rabigh oil sites, no barrels lost so far.
news.why: Oil headline risk is the main swing factor for NQ gaps; a fresh strike can erase the bounce.

news.headline: Friday: 10y yield hit ~5.00% and CME showed ~71% odds of a December hike as oil revived inflation fears.
news.why: Yields near 5% cap tech multiples; a hawkish Warsh Wed would hit NQ hardest.

news.headline: Trump says the US 'will not strike Iran today', 48 hours after floating another operation.
news.why: Takes some war-risk premium out of oil; supports the bounce in tech.

news.headline: Trump: 'getting to be decision time' on an Iran deal or resumed attacks; strikes could resume after the Nov 3 midterms.
news.why: Headline gap risk stays live all week; oil spike = NQ down.

news.headline: US is cutting diplomatic and military staffing in parts of the Middle East as Iran and Houthi threats rise.
news.why: Signals escalation risk; keeps oil bid and tech under pressure.

news.headline: FOMC Wed: 94 of 100 economists expect a hold at 3.75-4.00%; CME implies about 10% odds of a hike. Watch the vote split.
news.why: Hawkish dissents or a December hike signal would hit NQ hardest.

news.headline: Thursday data: Q3 GDP seen near 3.0% (GDPNow 3.5%); core PCE seen +0.3% m/m, 3.1% y/y.
news.why: Hot PCE + strong GDP = hike fears; a big 8:30 AM mover for NQ.

news.headline: Alphabet, Microsoft (about $3.9T each) and Amazon ($2.7T) report within two days: about $10.5T of market cap.
news.why: The top NQ weights; their AI capex comments decide tech direction after META's selloff.

news.headline: Chipmakers gauge on its longest run of weekly losses since November; BofA's Hartnett stays 'tactically risk-off until mid-Nov'.
news.why: Semis lead NQ; weak breadth limits how far a bounce can run.

takeaway: NQ futures are holding about +0.6% Sunday night as WTI cools to ~$101.6 (Brent ~$115) after Trump ruled out an Iran strike today. The week is decided by FOMC Wed 2 PM (hold expected, but Dec hike odds are live with 10y near 5%), MSFT/GOOGL/KLAC Wed AMC, then GDP + Core PCE 8:30 AM and AMZN/INTC Thursday.
